engineMain.how: git merge-base --is-ancestor of each cited commit against the fetched private main head; exit 0 means the commit is part of main

hero.title: The HQ on duty
hero.line: The Odin Labs HQ at dawn, the Engineering floor with one desk per lane, a review that glows until a person looks, the trust wall, and the outbox that waits for the founder’s click.
hero.real: Each shot is labelled in the frame: REAL shots are captures of the running campus, RENDER shots are Blender renders of the same released art.

source.note: Cut from the campus trailer v1.1, as released and pinned by its manifest, and re-encoded to 720p so it fits the page.
source.dropped: Left out of the original 78.5 s: a shot showing internal lane names (24 to 34 s), a rehearsal standup shot of a synthetic tenant (55 to 61 s), and the crowd, dusk and closing shots after it.

screening.method: one frame every 5 s, decoded with ffmpeg as raw rgb24 and hashed, viewed by an AI agent (the worker), not by a human
screening.ocr: Every frame at 2 per second (89 frames) and the poster were read for text and searched for file paths, addresses, ports, host and user names, machine details and private names: none found. The only text is the film’s own captions and its RENDER and REAL labels.

steps.label: Where it started
steps.line: The first build: simple shapes in a small 3D world, real answers with a proof card each.

steps.label: The hires HQ
steps.line: The Engineering hall rebuilt in high resolution: timber fins, a glass front, a desk per lane inside and skylights on the roof.
steps.alt: The Engineering hall of the Odin Labs HQ, rendered: the building from outside, its desk floor inside and its roof from above.
